name: PR detail Files changed tab renders the reviewer-ordered diff
description: From PR #482, open the Files changed tab and confirm the Smart Diff (L03) groups the seeded nine files by role: the 'Core logic' header is present, so is a core file (src/middleware/ratelimit.ts) and the lock file (package-lock.json) the classifier must put in Boilerplate. Exercises useSmartDiff → SmartDiffViewer → FileCard over GET /pulls/:id/smart-diff, which makes no model call. Read-only seeded data. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
